LUAD.discovery_selection_rule: Highest historical-CV mean Precision@100; ties resolved by mean AUPRC then lower absolute score-degree Spearman correlation
LUAD.constrained_top100_selection_rule: Lowest historical-CV mean top-100 STRING-hub fraction among configurations retaining at least 95% of the RWR historical-CV mean Precision@100
LUAD.bias_selection_rule: Lowest mean absolute score-degree Spearman among configurations with historical-CV mean AUPRC >= 95% of the performance-optimal configuration
